motor.title: File:Industrial Electric Motor and Drive Mechanism.jpg
motor.author: LJamesCPH
motor.description: Positioned on a sturdy metal frame next to a weathered concrete or brick wall, an industrial electric motor drives a mechanical transmission system. The equipment includes a belt-driven pulley connected to a vertical handwheel, as well as a secondary chain linkage extending toward the wall. Covered in a layer of dust and grime, the heavy-duty machinery shows signs of regular industrial use in a practical workspace environment. Connected wiring runs along the base near a wall-mounted junction box, capturing the gritty details and mechanical setup of operational back-of-house utility equipment.

plumbing.description: BACAU, Timor-Leste (Feb. 11, 2025) Utilityman 2nd class, Anthony Garcia from Las Vegas, Nevada, assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion 3 (NMCB-3), and Sgt Jacob Arnold from Grenada, Mississippi, assigned to 7th ESB Marines and attached to NMCB-3 begin the installation process for rough-in plumping, beginning to layout the pipes for all necessary utilities in the bathroom for the office space. NMCB-3 serves as the stand-in engineering force for Commander U.S. 7th Fleet, executing high-quality construction operations, activities, and investments. The battalion operates at the unit-of-action level to support major combat operations in the U.S. Indo-Pacific Command area of responsibility, with expertise in airfield, waterfront, and advanced base construction.
